notes: All 14 source and 16 target IDs partitioned exactly once; no invented IDs.

Jehovah (t002) is correctly its own unit rather than folded into the fronted verb: rule 17's pronoun permission reaches only a pronoun realizing the verb's person and number, not an explicit subject noun.
אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד carries no article morpheme, so the single written the is supplied on the construct under rule 29; מוֹעֵד takes the relational of under rule 19.
The לְ of לֵאמֹר is unrepresented under rule 27, and מֵ → out of is one compound rendering headed on out under rule 24.
